About ZSA

A clinical system, not a collection of scalp points.

Zhu’s Scalp Acupuncture is presented on this educational platform as a structured clinical approach developed by Professor Ming Qing Zhu.

Assessment → treatment → reassessment.

Teaching begins with the patient’s functional presentation and a clearly defined clinical question. Treatment zones and technique are then selected within a broader strategy, followed by immediate reassessment.

This website separates historical documentation, educational interpretation and clinical observation. Individual cases are not presented as guarantees of outcome.
